question:
Choose the word that means the same as the given word.

Daring
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Daring"** means willing to take risks; showing a lack of fear. (साहसी)

 
 
• **Example: **Her **daring** rescue of the child from the burning building earned her a medal of bravery.
 
 
 
• **"Fearless"** refers to someone who is not afraid of anything, showing courage. (निर्भीक)
 
 
• **Example: **The **fearless** firefighter ran into the burning building to save lives.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the meaning of **'Daring'** is **'Fearless'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Patience** (धैर्य): The capacity to accept or tolerate delay, trouble, or suffering without getting angry or upset.

 
 
• **Example:** She showed great **patience** as she waited for the slow computer to load.
 
 
 
• **Coward** (कायर): A person who lacks the courage to do or endure dangerous or unpleasant things.
 
 
• **Example:** He was called a **coward **for not standing up to the bully.
 
 
 
• **Trepid** (कंपन): This word is not commonly used in English and is likely a **misspelling or misinterpretation** of** "trepidation**," which means a feeling of fear or agitation about something that may happen.
 
 
• **Example:** She felt a sense of **trepidation** as she approached the dark alley.
